name: Quiet push and drift
summary: A slow scale-up with a small lateral drift, held under the threshold where the move announces itself.
mediaPrerequisites: enough resolution that the end scale does not soften the frame
refusalConditions: end scale would exceed the source resolution
subject sits at the frame edge and would be cropped by the push
qualityChecks: end scale stays within source resolution so the frame does not soften
motion reads as intentional rather than drifting
no edge of the source enters frame at any point
final keyframe lands on the last addressable frame
failureModes: scaling past source resolution and softening the image
a move fast enough to read as a camera mistake
a keyframe emitted at the clip end boundary, which renders but cannot be selected or edited

riskGates.basis: Still dimensions and admitted transform channels are checked before construction.

safetyGates.basis: The emitter channels are exact and revalidated at admission.

provenance.claim: Final Cut animates video effect parameters with keyframes
position is percent of frame height, not pixels; keyframe times are absolute from a 3600s origin for stills
the generated transform and opacity construction returns from Final Cut structurally identical
an imported transform keyframe is editable in place and recomputes correctly

validation.notes: Playback confirmed in the isolated app 2026-08-05: push, drift, and fade all visible.

notes: The restraint is the technique. If the move is noticeable as a move, it is too strong.
safety: Review the result on representative media before use.
